name: isPowerShellConstrainedLanguageEnforced
definition: PowerShell runs in constrained language mode on every Windows device: an App Control for Business (WDAC) policy with user-mode code integrity, or an AppLocker script rule, is enforced and assigned to all devices. Ruling recorded in the file: WDAC or AppLocker in enforce mode, assigned to all devices, counts.
population: App Control and device-configuration policies read from Intune, with their assignments
evidenceRequiredForTrue: an enforce-mode WDAC or AppLocker policy assigned to all devices, per the file's mode and assignment rules

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: Not reviewed in detail beyond the file's own docstring; the exact policy-mode rules are in the file.
